title: Infoschematic

id.description: Stable identifier for this document, unique across the documents shown together.

title.description: The name the document is known by.

subtitle.description: A qualifying line shown beneath the title.

description.description: What the document is for, in a sentence or two.

x.description: Distance from the left edge of the drawing area, in diagram units.

y.description: Distance from the top edge of the drawing area, in diagram units.

bounds.description: The drawing area every element is placed within.

gridSize.description: The spacing elements snap to while being edited. 0 disables snapping.

style.description: The treatment the drawing is painted in. `neutral` is the plain treatment; `blueprint` is a drafting convention. A style is realised on whichever ground the reader is on, so it does not decide light or dark.

surface.description: The former name for `style`, accepted so existing documents keep working. `style` wins where both are written.

mode.description: The ground the document would like to be read on. `system` declines to choose and follows the reader, which is what absence means.

modeLocked.description: Whether the reader may change the mode away from the one this document authored.

grid.description: The ruled ground behind the drawing. `major` rules a coarse grid, `major-plus-minor` subdivides it, `dots` marks the intersections only, and `none` leaves the ground plain.

identity.description: Whether elements show their identity chip. `card.identity` answers for Cards where both are set.

compact.description: Draw Cards condensed, trading detail for density.

stereotype.description: Show each Card's stereotype, the classifying line above its label.

description.description: Show each Card's description beneath its label.

card.description: What every Card discloses. A renderer may disclose less where there is no room for it.

appearance.description: Document-wide treatment every element inherits unless it says otherwise.

collections.description: Named groupings a Card can belong to, so several Cards share one identity.

fill.description: Fill colour, as any CSS colour. Read as a hue seed and realised against the ground the drawing is read on. End it with `!` to draw it exactly as written.

appearance.description: How this element is drawn, overriding the document-wide treatment.
